text:
alex: Heads-up — opened a tiny PR that moves `runtime/telemetry/collector.go` into `runtime/ops/telemetry/collector.go` to group collectors. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4567

approvals-bot: CODEOWNERS check: no path owner found for `runtime/ops/telemetry/*` — blocking merge. Rule: paths must have at least one approver.

maya: ah, we moved stuff during the service split. CODEOWNERS still has `runtime/telemetry/*` pointed at @eng-telemetry.

jon: who from eng-runtime can sign off? I can review the code, but CODEOWNERS wants the telemetry team specifically.

paul: quick Q: is this a behavior change or just a move?

alex: purely a move + small tidy, no behavior change. Unit tests pass.

maya: ok if it's pure move i can be temporary approver. But we should update CODEOWNERS so future moves don't block.

jon: sgtm. Two steps: (1) someone with merge rights to click approve on the PR, (2) follow-up PR to CODEOWNERS to add the `runtime/ops/telemetry/` path and point to `@eng-runtime` or a combined alias.

alex: can @maya click approve? I'll add you as a reviewer. If you approve I'll merge once CI green.

maya: added a quick review now. Left one nit about an import order but not blocking. Approving anyway — :thumbsup:

approvals-bot: PR review by maya recorded. Merge allowed after branch CI passes.

alex: thanks. I'll merge after the other CI job completes (should be ~5m). I'll also open a follow-up PR to CODEOWNERS: link will be in this thread when created.

paul: for the follow-up, can we add `path: runtime/ops/telemetry/* -> team: @eng-runtime` and also add a note in PR description about the monorepo reorg? avoids the mystery next time.

jon: also suggest adding an alias `@eng-observability` that includes eng-runtime+eng-telemetry, if we want cross-team reviews default. But that's larger discussion, not blocking this tiny change.

maya: agree. For now I'll approve this move. Alex, ping me if you need me to be listed in CODEOWNERS temporarily.

alex: merged — thanks all. Follow-up CODEOWNERS PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4570 (adds `runtime/ops/telemetry/* -> @eng-runtime`).

maya: nice. One action item: eng-platform, can we add a check in the repo health dashboard for orphaned paths reported by the CODEOWNERS linter? low-priority but helpful.

jon: filing a tiny ticket for that in /board.

paul: tl;dr: moved files, temporary approval given, merged, and CODEOWNERS updated in a follow-up PR.

alex: closing the loop — thanks everyone :tada:
